questions.q: The willingness of an individual to invest time and money into a venture despite the possibility of financial loss is known as:
questions.explain: **Risk-taking** is a fundamental personal quality of an entrepreneur. It involves stepping into the unknown and committing resources with the understanding that the venture could either yield profits or result in failure.

questions.q: Which of the following is **NOT** a desirable personal quality of a successful entrepreneur?
questions.explain: Successful entrepreneurs must be proactive, hard-working, and persistent. **Procrastination** (delaying tasks unnecessarily) is a negative trait that hinders business growth and execution.

questions.q: An entrepreneur who constantly seeks new and better ways to package, market, and deliver goods to consumers is exhibiting which of the following qualities?
questions.explain: **Innovativeness** refers to the ability to introduce new ideas, original methods, or improved products. It is what keeps a business competitive in a changing market.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Entrepreneurial Skill, Consumer & Society

questions.q: The ability of an entrepreneur to remain steadfast and continue pursuing business goals despite facing initial setbacks or challenges is referred to as:
questions.explain: **Persistence** (or perseverance) is the determination to keep trying despite difficulties. Business landscapes are filled with challenges, and an entrepreneur must not give up easily when facing obstacles.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Entrepreneurial Skill, Consumer & Society

questions.q: A successful entrepreneur must possess a strong belief in their own abilities and business ideas to convince investors and customers. This quality is known as:
questions.explain: **Self-confidence** is the trust a person has in their own judgments and abilities. Without it, an entrepreneur will struggle to lead a team or secure funding.
